# Mezmo

Mezmo provides a comprehensive platform for log management and telemetry data processing, enabling organizations to collect, analyze, and manage their log data efficiently.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mezmo/.

## Actions

- **Delete Pipeline Alert**: Delete an alert for a specific component within a pipeline.
- **Ingest logs to Mezmo**: Ingest log events to mezmo.
